preconditions.expression: root is None or isinstance(root, TreeNode)
preconditions.description: The input root must be either None or a TreeNode object.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.val <= 10**5 for node in [root] + [node.left for node in [root] if root] + [node.right for node in [root] if root]) if root else True
preconditions.description: All node values must be integers between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == sum(1 for _ in inorder_traversal(root)) if root else True
postconditions.description: The length of the returned list must equal the number of nodes in the tree.

postconditions.expression: return_value == inorder_traversal(root) if root else True
postconditions.description: The returned list must be the inorder traversal of the tree (left subtree, root, right subtree).
